summary: Frontend E2E test of the Blue Light Contract Onboarding Import (CRM → Contracts → Blue Light tab). Logged in via the platform login (/login?next=/crm — /crm bounces to /login by design), switched CRM to Corporate mode, created a throwaway contract 'Import QA Contract 1787949623', used the enable-and-import entry (bl-enable-import) which enabled Blue Light AND opened bl-import-panel, downloaded the template, uploaded the Kenya CSV, verified the pre-commit validation summary, committed, verified the result banner + station matrix refresh, then re-ran the same CSV to prove duplicate-on-contract detection, tested the paste path, input validation and a bad-file upload. ALL primary acceptance criteria PASSED; no functional defects found.

design_issues.screen: CRM Blue Light tab — 'Bulk plan visits' row (pre-existing, not part of this feature)
issues: Uses native browser date inputs (mm/dd/yyyy placeholders / native picker) instead of the shadcn calendar component; also US date order in a UK-facing app
/crm?tab=contracts is ignored — app lands on the Members-mode Dashboard; Contracts only reachable after switching to Corporate mode (crm-mode-business). Minor discoverability/deep-link gap.

action_items: OPTIONAL (low): blank-serial rows are not de-dupable — after the successful import, re-previewing the SAME Kenya CSV still offers 'Import 5 assets into 4 stations' (the 5 no-serial rows). Committing twice would create 5 duplicate serial-less assets. Consider a soft dedupe key (station+manufacturer+model+asset_number) or an explicit warning that no-serial rows will be re-created.
OPTIONAL (low): support /crm?tab=contracts deep link (currently ignored; needs Corporate mode switch first).
Housekeeping: delete the throwaway QA contract 'Import QA Contract 1787949623' (CTR-4BBBF2, org iso-demo-org) which now holds 4 stations / 107 assets.
Unrelated console noise: React 'unique key prop' warning from StagnatingDeals on the CRM dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: BlueLightImportPanel is well-scoped (~240 lines), every interactive element has a data-testid, loading/error/success states all handled, multipart upload lets the browser set the boundary — no issues found.
commit posts back preview.rows verbatim; server re-validates (verified via the second preview flagging dup_on_contract), so no trust issue observed.
seed_data_creation: Throwaway CRM contract 'Import QA Contract 1787949623' (CTR-4BBBF2) under iso-demo-org with Blue Light enabled, 4 stations (Nyati Gym, FMB Nyati, Med Centre & PCRF, Kifaru Gym) and 107 imported assets (11 treadmills). Demo contract CTR-BLFRS1 was only read/previewed — nothing committed there (its stats remain 82 stations / 470 assets).
test_credentials: owner@isodemo.com / IsoDemo123! — NOTE: must log in via the PLATFORM login at /login?next=/crm (the standalone CRM login form is never shown; /crm redirects to /login). Then CRM → Corporate mode (data-testid crm-mode-business) → crm-nav-contracts.

detailed_results.1_enable_and_import_entry: PASS — bl-enable-import enabled Blue Light and opened bl-import-panel in one click.
detailed_results.3_upload_preview_counts: PASS — Stations(new)=4, Stations(existing)=0, Assets=108, Treadmills=11, Duplicates=1, No serial=5 (exact match to expectations). Nothing created at preview time (overview stats still 0 stations).
detailed_results.4_station_breakdown: PASS — 4 rows, all tagged 'new': Nyati Gym 55 assets/7 treadmills, FMB Nyati 19/1, Med Centre & PCRF 16/2, Kifaru Gym 18/1.
detailed_results.5_warnings_box: PASS — bl-import-warnings shows 6 warnings: 5 missing-serial rows (50, 51, 92, 95, 109) + 1 in-file duplicate (Row 107 serial 22018429).
detailed_results.6_commit: PASS — skip-dupes checked by default; button label 'Import 107 assets into 4 stations'; green bl-import-result: 'Imported 107 assets across 4 new stations. 1 duplicate skipped. 11 treadmills detected for calibration.'
detailed_results.7_refresh_after_commit: PASS — BL overview refreshed to STATIONS 4 / 107 assets / 11 treadmills, CERTIFICATES 0/4, 4 matrix rows (bl-station-row-*), and header tabs updated to Sites (4) / Assets (107).
detailed_results.8_duplicate_on_contract: PASS — re-uploading the same CSV gave Stations(new)=0, Stations(existing)=4, Duplicates=103, 109 warnings ('Serial X already exists on this contract'), commit label reduced to 'Import 5 assets into 4 stations' (the 5 no-serial rows).
detailed_results.9_paste_path: PASS — paste mode + default station 'QA Paste Station' → 1 new station, 2 assets, 1 treadmill, 0 duplicates (not committed).
detailed_results.10_import_toggle_existing_contract: PASS — bl-import-toggle shows/hides the same panel on both the QA contract and the existing 82-station CTR-BLFRS1.
detailed_results.11_validation_error_handling: PASS — 'Choose a CSV or Excel file first.' (no file), 'Paste some rows first.' (empty paste), and a friendly 'No data rows found in the file' for a non-spreadsheet .txt upload; no crash, no preview rendered.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth path for CRM tests: go to /login?next=/crm, fill gx-login-email / gx-login-password, submit; then click crm-mode-business and crm-nav-contracts (Contracts is NOT in Members mode, and ?tab=contracts is ignored). Kenya CSV cached at /tmp/kenya.csv. QA contract 'Import QA Contract 1787949623' already has the Kenya import committed — re-previewing it is a ready-made duplicate-on-contract fixture.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects to root-cause. Initial test failures were environmental/test-side only: (a) /crm redirects unauthenticated users to the platform /login (CRMApp.js ~line 703), and (b) the CRM mode testids are crm-mode-leisure / crm-mode-business (not 'corporate'). Test script was corrected accordingly.
